name: Shell
description: Execute commands in the active platform shell. Uses Bash-compatible shell commands on Linux/macOS and PowerShell commands on Windows.

executeCommand.description: Execute a command in the active platform shell and return the result.
executeCommand.progressive_guidance: This tool waits for command completion; longRunning only extends the timeout. Run finite tasks directly. Bash commands use ordinary exit-status semantics; fail-fast behavior requires an explicit set -e. Use && for dependent operations and test optional programs/files in if conditions so expected absence is reported without aborting an inventory scan. The final command determines the exit status unless the script exits explicitly; nonzero status is reported with captured stdout and stderr. For existing background work, check its result before waiting again.

longRunning.description: Set true only for commands expected to run for a long time. Uses a deterministic 24-hour timeout.
